Select IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human JAK3 (CHEMBL2148). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary, filtering by target CHEMBL2148 and standard_type IC50. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Join docs to retrieve pubmed_id or doi. Join compound_records to retrieve compound_key. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Output columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
